stages.name: Protectionism and living standards
stages.title: Protectionism and living standards
stages.sub: After this the student can explain how tariffs and quotas end up squeezing households' living standards.

steps.q: A tariff pushes the price of imported clothes up. Your wages stay exactly the same as before. If you spend the same wage on clothes now costing more, has what your wage is actually worth to you changed?
steps.hint: The pound in your pocket is the same number, but think about what it can be exchanged for now.
